stages.label: Retained seed populations and distance-only replay

design.repeatedWork: The winning standard seed is counted for raw-distance Estimate, then its unchanged literal/cache/length population is counted again to initialize plane-distance Trace prices.
design.endState: Prepare operation-owned per-seed counts and raw estimated cost once. Retain the standard seed preparation across repeated-seed comparison. If tracing is selected, rebuild ONLY40distance bins from copy tokens using Plane+Prefix, then price borrowed prepared populations. Independent traced/selected token owners remain unchanged. No global cache or public API.
stages: Extract maintained seed-population cost/preparation with explicit raw versus plane-distance representations. Keep complete-token Fill as the actual standalone production fallback, not a test-only implementation.
Integrate main and boxed parsing reuse; evaluate auxiliary parsing only where the same concrete repeated seed path is present. No shape/depth/filter/quality grid.
If useful, later consolidate one-token versus complete-span accumulation without adding a generic per-pixel abstraction; do not mix an unsupported second hypothesis into initial scoring.
correctness: Every non-distance count and both distance representations equal independent original full Fill results for literal/cache/copy mixtures. Retain raw cost despite later plane remapping.
Exact Estimate values, trace prices, selected token/index words, cache bits, candidate ties and complete frozen packets. Do not reuse counts across different seeds/cache representations.

Borrow inputs/root. Reserve capacity before allocation, track any earlier overlap, no denial fallback, clean refusal/cancel/exception at every ownership boundary. Disposing preparation must not invalidate independent surviving token output.
design.temporaryCosts: The standard histogram remains live during repeated-seed estimation, potentially increasing an early local peak by one small alphabet-sized buffer. Trace no longer allocates/refills the same literal histogram. Distance-only second pass remains necessary; wrapper/object and lifetime complexity must earn its cost. Measure actual allocation/peak/retention; no assumed CPU gain.
workloads: Existing transparent lossy Encode8 with lossless alpha, FFmpeg complete-operation and exact98590Bpacket gates.
Existing lossless photograph, explicitly labeled libwebp exact=1 and exact160032Bpacket gates.
One existing authored small control only if useful for generalization; diagram passing performance stays stopped.
design.cadence: Focused correctness first, reuse immutable builds for short complete-operation screens, independent confirmation if justified, broad Win/Linux/scalar/differential/same actual package at accepted coherent milestone. Preserve adverse/inconclusive data; no favorable resampling.

screen.note: Reuse existing complete public WorkspaceScreen unchanged: photo/diagram/transparentVP8/authoredbars.
